Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 41, "heading": "CHAPTER 39. WICKFIELD AND HEEP", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u041-b0030", "target": "— Ах, Агнес! — сказал я, когда мы сели рядом. — Как мне вас недоставало в последнее время!", "source_sha256": "2b01363d91782ef25744ebc1920d81d6036d1a899356c3e7e0fd316dc7e60a25", "target_id": "ru-en85-u041-b0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "a89efd1fea0284316f06d0b00e95c36124fdb3e61e08a7cbcb3125e50423412f"}, {"source_id": "en85-u041-b0031", "target": "— Вправду? — отвечала она. — Опять! И так скоро?", "source_sha256": "224ecbfe662f10f1eca1f58d9489c6bd94cfb1f899f1740c9246c8e235f51d80", "target_id": "ru-en85-u041-b0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "908134d1eff246c461f32b240b8511624c383ff697b5bcf4abad3add7d5d4691"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 39, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u041-b0032", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I shook my head.", "sha256": "b3679f6433a09f79fc243adb2760a16f6fa50a9f55daa0a90322a198909b28e5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[32]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0033", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I don’t know how it is, Agnes; I seem to want some faculty of mind that I ought to have. You were so much in the habit of thinking for me, in the happy old days here, and I came so naturally to you for counsel and support, that I really think I have missed acquiring it.’", "sha256": "29ad3d01617c96e06bf4a95bdd35291b9214bbaa626b1696de2d9e44b3142447", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[33]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0034", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘And what is it?’ said Agnes, cheerfully.", "sha256": "cae240b5ae4ea0856cdfd01f3b64192875dc7b9656be2789537692898ace3d81", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[34]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0035", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I don’t know what to call it,’ I replied. ‘I think I am earnest and persevering?’", "sha256": "d768f7a6e06f47e0db5c2f17ff3aa2c1c6a4d03c7d943055f4586527fa3c52d8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[35]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0036", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I am sure of it,’ said Agnes.", "sha256": "b5852097b2d01f9180e6fb843f422e6e7e1684a113d9af676f98d26a7f335762", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[36]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0037", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘And patient, Agnes?’ I inquired, with a little hesitation.", "sha256": "0c065ffd53ddb93b88a73f0ef17cbf0892c5adb1e35d0c2d6992d0b6b91d7551", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[37]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0038", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes,’ returned Agnes, laughing. ‘Pretty well.’", "sha256": "873d28fff97871086c0971b35db74029c8f1128a2c4405b881b8154d0bb7dfb3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[38]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0039", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘And yet,’ said I, ‘I get so miserable and worried, and am so unsteady and irresolute in my power of assuring myself, that I know I must want—shall I call it—reliance, of some kind?’", "sha256": "17dd751b4e4282432afdf233bb42fea323b017e6595058d57d2450a38282d783", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[39]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0040", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Call it so, if you will,’ said Agnes.", "sha256": "4fe4d33605e12621dcfa4e81667cda9ce3ad88d897849bc0c3a4ac4d8a9982f5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[40]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0041", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Well!’ I returned. ‘See here! You come to London, I rely on you, and I have an object and a course at once. I am driven out of it, I come here, and in a moment I feel an altered person. The circumstances that distressed me are not changed, since I came into this room; but an influence comes over me in that short interval that alters me, oh, how much for the better! What is it? What is your secret, Agnes?’", "sha256": "061287524ab782c590255733fa427b53b53269baca18f1fb67d063dcd58851be", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[41]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0042", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Her head was bent down, looking at the fire.", "sha256": "30d7a7f605ac0e73f364819fca48a9e3c3822bfeaf17f314d9dc7da7cd760b5a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[42]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0043", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It’s the old story,’ said I. ‘Don’t laugh, when I say it was always the same in little things as it is in greater ones. My old troubles were nonsense, and now they are serious; but whenever I have gone away from my adopted sister—’", "sha256": "f0ea6c1b6b0dd7e7a22d6f7f676c810ec466c411b4db9efe31c1fe338a5a6c0d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[43]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0044", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Agnes looked up—with such a Heavenly face!—and gave me her hand, which I kissed.", "sha256": "53e7f409d95772df08e411ec32a457bca30048c8a19b9261ffb6d740ca1c35cc", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[44]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0045", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Whenever I have not had you, Agnes, to advise and approve in the beginning, I have seemed to go wild, and to get into all sorts of difficulty. When I have come to you, at last (as I have always done), I have come to peace and happiness. I come home, now, like a tired traveller, and find such a blessed sense of rest!’", "sha256": "b51fa5791909ad53f2c10abfbdf56aa09e691c0252a4f50bdc518ef6ebef5ce9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[45]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0046", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I felt so deeply what I said, it affected me so sincerely, that my voice failed, and I covered my face with my hand, and broke into tears. I write the truth. Whatever contradictions and inconsistencies there were within me, as there are within so many of us; whatever might have been so different, and so much better; whatever I had done, in which I had perversely wandered away from the voice of my own heart; I knew nothing of. I only knew that I was fervently in earnest, when I felt the rest and peace of having Agnes near me.", "sha256": "1a47a67d15d082b69d1c45ba75bd093079d274ffbc2e568e04e0b70fffcb2cee", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[46]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0047", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "In her placid sisterly manner; with her beaming eyes; with her tender voice; and with that sweet composure, which had long ago made the house that held her quite a sacred place to me; she soon won me from this weakness, and led me on to tell all that had happened since our last meeting.", "sha256": "0972b40f1d6309163442a3e8348b6302c0ac32306e21a4f940f3f6e807f23ec2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[47]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0048", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘And there is not another word to tell, Agnes,’ said I, when I had made an end of my confidence. ‘Now, my reliance is on you.’", "sha256": "af1a148141132dd0d9bd58c05a50b51ea15242ae88c59e5a98a99d592eb773ff", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[48]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0049", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘But it must not be on me, Trotwood,’ returned Agnes, with a pleasant smile. ‘It must be on someone else.’", "sha256": "5fec7ae2a269607635dc670364a5a9d8ff66d497d7d02a26076e727b298f91e8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[49]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0050", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘On Dora?’ said I.", "sha256": "d10adffc1999527891f1ef1791327116accd1a7b7cc61f9dc06aac00670980e6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[50]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0051", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Assuredly.’", "sha256": "08f77e7954627e060b2eaf674eb58608a33121fe5fe8d7c011151d2e50bb0c28", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[51]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0052", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Why, I have not mentioned, Agnes,’ said I, a little embarrassed, ‘that Dora is rather difficult to—I would not, for the world, say, to rely upon, because she is the soul of purity and truth—but rather difficult to—I hardly know how to express it, really, Agnes. She is a timid little thing, and easily disturbed and frightened. Some time ago, before her father’s death, when I thought it right to mention to her—but I’ll tell you, if you will bear with me, how it was.’", "sha256": "591b019d936015684e434efaad2f13a1c2005ec5c340e9bf4c98372d460b53ee", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[52]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0053", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Accordingly, I told Agnes about my declaration of poverty, about the cookery-book, the housekeeping accounts, and all the rest of it.", "sha256": "564897dbd245a5d2fd892c0ba06a77b111a18721c073843eab7dc1cec3b16ede", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[53]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0054", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, Trotwood!’ she remonstrated, with a smile. ‘Just your old headlong way! You might have been in earnest in striving to get on in the world, without being so very sudden with a timid, loving, inexperienced girl. Poor Dora!’", "sha256": "5c9ef1ef2325414468a4901d09fd6a941ba9f07728173c2350be41dcbfa5756d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[54]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0055", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I never heard such sweet forbearing kindness expressed in a voice, as she expressed in making this reply. It was as if I had seen her admiringly and tenderly embracing Dora, and tacitly reproving me, by her considerate protection, for my hot haste in fluttering that little heart. It was as if I had seen Dora, in all her fascinating artlessness, caressing Agnes, and thanking her, and coaxingly appealing against me, and loving me with all her childish innocence.", "sha256": "f95755486c18306d911b6524153401f6d5a9a73b5579241af7df468a39d2bac8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[55]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0056", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I felt so grateful to Agnes, and admired her so! I saw those two together, in a bright perspective, such well-associated friends, each adorning the other so much!", "sha256": "ce0e382435621fbe24341f09b7e14453fe0a8961828f62ee0d7d8f6b772f3b8b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[56]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0057", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What ought I to do then, Agnes?’ I inquired, after looking at the fire a little while. ‘What would it be right to do?’", "sha256": "049f5a6e00ccc82e1b189ce4c8a6078b11708653386078e4f16d827a122d3a7c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[57]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0058", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I think,’ said Agnes, ‘that the honourable course to take, would be to write to those two ladies. Don’t you think that any secret course is an unworthy one?’", "sha256": "b2f8b161304d9a9f97fbafb1b58a89ed658e3a97323f1e3e02f70269ab678b40", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[58]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0059", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes. If YOU think so,’ said I.", "sha256": "94bd1d6e90b19568ad76d1e8eee45bad93ef607032269e53fcd7140537e9f92b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[59]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0060", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I am poorly qualified to judge of such matters,’ replied Agnes, with a modest hesitation, ‘but I certainly feel—in short, I feel that your being secret and clandestine, is not being like yourself.’", "sha256": "cf3adff19318941beffd4e356659b261ed6de1f39dd5b3584fa51f8b20573ad5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[60]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0061", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Like myself, in the too high opinion you have of me, Agnes, I am afraid,’ said I.", "sha256": "86f522e0fbf9326caa93a8e6edebf45fb85da74cc9f4f039948fb69dc4739dba", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[61]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0062", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Like yourself, in the candour of your nature,’ she returned; ‘and therefore I would write to those two ladies. I would relate, as plainly and as openly as possible, all that has taken place; and I would ask their permission to visit sometimes, at their house. Considering that you are young, and striving for a place in life, I think it would be well to say that you would readily abide by any conditions they might impose upon you. I would entreat them not to dismiss your request, without a reference to Dora; and to discuss it with her when they should think the time suitable. I would not be too vehement,’ said Agnes, gently, ‘or propose too much. I would trust to my fidelity and perseverance—and to Dora.’", "sha256": "46c802dae64cde7a07840bb89d50c0117080c681829874363cb3ed91024a96af", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[62]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0063", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘But if they were to frighten Dora again, Agnes, by speaking to her,’ said I. ‘And if Dora were to cry, and say nothing about me!’", "sha256": "b7a403fcfc7a80d9d53270df0dd9465e9a6be9445b794c9ec03349c1217ecddf", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[63]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
